title: Generation lip sync
description: Makes the person in a video speak a voice track, made by the generation server.
pick_when: A person on screen who has to say exact words: a clip with one visible speaker plus a voiceover (from the voiceover workflow). Among the more expensive tools: priced per second of the result.

labels.1:file: Video with ONE clearly visible speaker
labels.2:audio: Voice track: the voiceover to speak
